ἄιστον: ἄιστος — unseen, vanished without trace (ἀ- + root of ἰδεῖν); masc. acc. sg.
ἄιστος: ἄιστος — unseen, vanished without trace; masc. nom. sg.
ἄλκιμος: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, valiant, brave (from ἀλκή); masc. nom. sg.
ἄνωγα: ἄνωγα — bid, command, order; perf. 1 sg. with pres. sense: ’I bid’
ἄνωχθι: ἄνωγα — bid, command; perf. imper. 2 sg.: ’bid! order!’
ἄξιον: ἄξιος — worth, worthy; neut. nom. sg., + gen.: ’worth (a return)’
ἄπυστος: ἄπυστος — unheard of, of whom nothing is learned (from root of πυνθάνομαι); masc. nom. sg.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel
ἄρσας: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, equip, fit out; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having fitted out’
ἅρπυιαι: Ἅρπυιαι — the Harpies, snatching storm-winds personified as beings that carry people off without trace (from ἁρπάζω); nom. pl.
ἐβόλοντο: βόλομαι — wish, will (epic by-form of βούλομαι); impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’willed’
ἐγείνατο: γείνομαι — beget, bear; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’bore’
ἐλθὲ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’go!’
ἐμεῦ: ἐγώ — I; gen. sg., epic (= Attic ἐμοῦ): ’from me’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
ἐμπάζεο: ἐμπάζομαι — heed, care for, take account of; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐμπάζου), + gen.
ἐμός: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg.
ἐμὴν: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. sg.
ἐμῶν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. gen. pl.
ἐνιαυτόν: ἐνιαυτός — year; acc. sg., accusative of duration: ’for a year’
ἐνόησα: νοέω — perceive, catch sight of, notice; aor. 1 sg., augmented
ἐπίμεινον: ἐπιμένω — wait, stay on, remain; aor. imper. 2 sg.
ἐπαλαστήσασα: ἐπαλαστέω — be indignant, be bitterly moved (rare verb, from ἄλαστος ’not to be forgotten’); aor. part. fem. nom. sg.
ἐπειγόμενός: ἐπείγω — press, urge on; mid./pass. ἐπείγομαι be in haste, press on; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., + gen.: ’pressing on (for the road)’
ἐπιδήμιος: ἐπιδήμιος — at home, in one’s own land (from δῆμος); masc. nom. sg.
ἐπικρατέουσιν: ἐπικρατέω — hold power over, rule; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic -οῦσιν), + dat.
ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν); conj. + subj.
ἐρέτῃσιν: ἐρέτης — rower, oarsman; dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
ἐρεείνεις: ἐρεείνω — ask, question (epic, from ἔρομαι); pres. 2 sg.
ἐστίν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable form
ἐφείη: ἐφίημι — send against, lay (hands) on; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’would lay (his hands) on’
ἐφορμᾶται: ἐφορμάω — stir up, urge on; mid./pass. ἐφορμάομαι be roused, be set upon; pres. 3 sg.: ’is set upon, urges’
ἐφύρης: Ἐφύρη — Ephyra, name of several towns (which one is meant here is uncertain); gen. sg.
ἐόντος: εἰμί — be; pres. part. gen. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντος): ’being, alive’
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑλών: αἱρέω — take, choose; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’picking out, choosing’
ἑοῖς: ἑός — his own, her own (by-form of the possessive ὅς); masc./neut. dat. pl.
ἑτάροισι: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἑτέρως: ἕτερος — other, otherwise; adv. ἑτέρως: ’otherwise, the other way’
ἑὸν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); masc. acc. sg.
ἔδοντες: ἔδω — eat (epic, = Attic ἐσθίω); pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’eating’
ἔεδνα: ἔεδνα — wedding gifts, bridal gifts (prothetic ἐ-, beside ἕδνα); neut. acc. pl.
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen., placed after its pronoun with anastrophe: τοῦ ... ἔκ = ἐκ τοῦ ’from him’
ἔκτα: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg., by-form ἔκτα (root aorist)
ἔλλαβε: λαμβάνω — take, win, get; aor. 3 sg., augmented with double λ, epic (= Attic ἔλαβε)
ἔοικε: ἔοικα — be fitting, seem; perf. with pres. sense, impersonal 3 sg.: ’it is fitting’
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its noun with anastrophe: ἑοῖς ἔπι ’upon his own (possessions)’
ἔπλετο: πέλομαι — be, become, happen; aor. 3 sg. used with pres. force: ’is’
ἔρανος: ἔρανος — a meal to which each guest contributes his share (as against a feast given by a host); nom. sg.
ἔρξῃς: ἔρδω — do, work, accomplish (= ῥέζω); aor. subj. 2 sg.
ἔρχεο: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔρχου)
ἔσσ: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic ἔσσο, elided (ἔσσ’ = ἔσσο; = Attic ἴσθι): ’be!’
ἔστων: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 3 pl., epic: ’let them be’
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, yet; adv., elided (ἔτ’ = ἔτι)
ἔτετμε: τέτμον (defective) — come upon, overtake; reduplicated aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’overtook’
ἔτευξαν: τεύχω — make, fashion, cause; aor. 3 pl., augmented
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕπεσθαι: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany, go with; pres. inf.: ’to go with, accompany’
ἠδέ: ἠδέ — and; epic conjunction, accented before an enclitic
ἡμετέρῳ: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; masc./neut. dat. sg.
ἤ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj., accented before an enclitic (ἤ κεν)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤρατ: ἄρνυμαι — win, gain, earn for oneself; aor. mid. 3 sg. ἤρατο, elided (ἤρατ’ = ἤρατο), augmented: ’won, gained’ (the verb of ἀρνύμενος at 1.5)
ἥρωας: ἥρως — hero, man of rank or noble birth; acc. pl.
ἦε: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), spelled ἦε in ἦε καὶ οὐκί ’or not’
ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
ἰσόθεος: ἰσόθεος — equal to a god, godlike (ἴσος + θεός); masc. nom. sg.
ἴλου: Ἶλος — Ilus, son of Mermerus, in Ephyra; gen. sg.
ἴτω: εἶμι — go; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let her go’
ὀίσατο: ὀίομαι — think, suppose, imagine; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented
ὀδυρόμενος: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’lamenting’
ὀδύνας: ὀδύνη — pain, grief, anguish; acc. pl.
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind; in Homer also ’hereafter, in time to come’; adv.
ὀχέειν: ὀχέω — carry, keep up, uphold; pres. inf., epic uncontracted: ’to carry on, keep up (childish ways)’
ὀψιγόνων: ὀψίγονος — late-born, born in later generations; masc. gen. pl.
ὁδοῖο: ὁδός — road, way, journey; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὁμιλήσειεν: ὁμιλέω — be in company with, meet, consort with; aor. opt. 3 sg., wish: ’might he come among’
ὁρόω: ὁράω — see; pres. 1 sg., epic stretched form (= Attic ὁρῶ)
ὁρόων: ὁράω — see; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic stretched (= Attic ὁρῶν): ’seeing’
ὄσσαν: ὄσσα — voice, rumour, report (personified, from Zeus); acc. sg.
ὄφελον: ὀφείλω — owe; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (Attic ὤφελον), with an infinitive, an unattainable wish: ’would that...’
ὅδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg., elided (ὅδ’ = ὅδε)
ὅμιλος: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng, gathering; nom. sg.
ὅππως: ὅπως — how, in what way; epic ὅππως (double π metri gratia), + subj.: ’how you are to...’
ὅσσα: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος (double σ), neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’as many as’
ὅσσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’as many as’ (correlative with τόσσοι)
ὑβρίζοντες: ὑβρίζω — act violently or insolently, commit outrage (from ὕβρις); pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’behaving insolently’
ὑπέμνησέν: ὑπομιμνῄσκω — remind; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ὑπ-έ-μνησεν), + gen.: ’made mindful of’
ὑποθήσομαι: ὑποτίθημι — suggest, advise, put before; fut. mid. 1 sg.: ’I will advise’
ὠκύμοροί: ὠκύμορος — swift-doomed, early-doomed (ὠκύς + μόρος); masc. nom. pl.
ὧδ: ὧδε — so, thus, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
ᾗσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl.: ’in his own (mind)’ (φρεσὶν ᾗσι)
ᾤχετο: οἴχομαι — be gone, go, have gone; impf. 3 sg., augmented (οἰ- → ᾠ-): ’had gone’
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)

__broaden__.αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl.: ’their own’ (reinforcing a possessive) · also plain neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, not reinforcing a possessive: ’them’ (λήσομαι αὐτῶν ’I will forget them’, of things said)
__broaden__.ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’)
__broaden__.εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’
__broaden__.ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or, before τε, unaccented ὡς ’as’
__broaden__.ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
__broaden__.κλέος: κλέος — fame, renown, report; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. (same form), direct object: μέγα κλέος ἤρατο ’won great fame’; κλέος φέρειν ’bring report’
__broaden__.τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
__broaden__.κεῖται: κεῖμαι — lie; pres. 3 sg., used of the dead: ’lies (dead)’ · also in the idiom θεῶν ἐν γούνασι κεῖται: ’rests with the gods, lies in the gods’ hands’ (of an outcome, not of the dead)
__broaden__.καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg. (agreeing with a noun) · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beautifully’ (with an infinitive) · also as direct object: ’a fine one’ (μάλα καλὸν ἑλών)
__broaden__.τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in such a way’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun or pronoun: ’such a one as’ (σέ γε τοῖον ἐγείνατο ’bore a son such as you’)
__broaden__.ἐμόν: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. voc. sg. (= nom./acc. in form; agrees with τέκνον) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: οἶκον ἐμόν ’my house’
__broaden__.ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
__broaden__.ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’)
__broaden__.ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη)
__broaden__.παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, among; + dat. · also + gen., ’from, from the side of’ (παρ’ Ἴλου ’from Ilus’)
__broaden__.τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’)
__broaden__.ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’
